name: AI Datasets
blurb: Training and evaluation datasets with size, licence, provenance, language coverage, and documented bias.

reading.body:
The AI Datasets section currently contains zero entries, so it offers a taxonomy for training and evaluation data rather than any actual datasets.

It splits the subject into three parts: training datasets, evaluation datasets, and dataset licensing and provenance. The stated attributes to track are size, licence, provenance, language coverage, and documented bias. That structure tells a reader what the site intends to measure, but none of those measurements exist yet.

This data says nothing about compute, buildings, or power. It is a placeholder for dataset records, not evidence about infrastructure constraints.
